immutable_rules: Supplied buildings, roads, sports fields, boundaries and circulation geometry are authoritative design data.
Never invent or reference object IDs absent from the project manifest.
All visible direct shadows must follow one sun vector.
All stochastic placement must include a seed.
Tools marked planned are allowed in plans but must be reported as unavailable until implemented.
campus_rules: Keep main entrances and primary facades visually unobstructed.
Keep sports markings and track geometry visible in aerial views.
Use people and vehicles to communicate scale, never to cover design features.
For blue-hour imagery combine cool ambient sky with restrained warm windows and street lights.
Use lower detail assets in distant context and reserve high detail for foreground hero areas.
